explanation: Retrospectively, this pole detects the ordinary public-world lexicon of local news reporting as a property of the words and their everyday senses rather than of the passage's register: local setting nouns (county, town, village, farm, house, home, hospital, jail, prison, beach, coast, land), people named by social role or kin (residents, immigrants, adults, seniors, natives, convict, doctors, mothers, family), life-course and location predicates (live, born, die/dead/alive, marry, be buried, exist, belong, stay, arrive, land, wait, be confined), time words (now, soon, tomorrow, the past, the future, years, months, every, currently) and the modal hedges can, could, might, may, probably and likely (less reliably will) with the negated auxiliaries isn't, wasn't, aren't, don't and didn't; the peak can also fall on the clause comma or relative who/whose beside such a word, and homographs are inert ('a can of peaches', 'read the will', 'still water', the month 'May'). It stays at the floor on specialized and abstract vocabulary (method, result, data, model, algorithm, format, segment, parameter, analysis, process, value, level, research, information, evidence, study, science, health), concrete artifacts, animals, body parts and foods (table, cup, book, key, car, dog, cat, fish, hand, blood, food, water), generic person words (women, men, children, students, patients, workers), large or civic geographic terms (city, country, state, nation, region, area, community, school, church, court, market, bank), adjectives and ordinary action verbs (walk, run, eat, say, make, use, work, help, need), and plain copulas, positive auxiliaries and deontic modals (is, was, are, be, has, have, do, does, would, should, must); it is not register-conditioned, so the class words fire inside code and scientific prose too (county as a code identifier peaks 1.20, can inside an ML abstract 0.75) and a passage stays quiet only when it has none of them ('The algorithm sorts the array and returns a segment of the original data' peaks 0.00).
